entities.name: Darien, King of Kjeldor
entities.description: The last king of Kjeldor, whose dream of unification was fulfilled; after him came the kings of New Argive.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: An ice civilization that Darien ruled as its last king.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The realm ruled by the kings who followed Darien.

entities.name: Darien's Roost
entities.description: A stronghold struck from two sides by the Knights of Stromgald.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: Attackers of Darien's Roost, thwarted by Darien's tacticians.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest to which Darien called for help; allied with Kjeldor.

entities.name: Order of the White Shield
entities.description: An order led by Lucilde Fiksdotter whose true shield is conviction.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: Leader of the Order of the White Shield.

entities.name: Heidar, Rimewind Master
entities.description: A Rimewind master who prefers ice, forced the sun into hiding, and wants the Thaw bleached away.

entities.name: Rimewind
entities.description: Wizards and cultists of Rimewind Keep who strive to perpetuate a magical winter.

entities.name: The Thaw
entities.description: The melting of the Ice Age caused by the World Spell, bringing flooding, disease, death and rifts.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Freyalise's spell that thawed Terisiare's graves and ice.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker whom the Disciple of Tevesh Szat says cannot hear pleas; spoke the World Spell.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A demon who claims souls, according to his disciple.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent suffering the Ice Age, with only cold and weird weather.

entities.name: Adarkar
entities.description: A land of blank wastes that make the mind wander.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: A plague-ridden city-tomb.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: A school whose fall left abandoned magical treasures.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: A figure for whom Heidar raised an army of bones at Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: A place Heidar claims, where Kjeldoran stragglers were pressed into Haakon's army.

entities.name: Frost Marsh
entities.description: A marsh to which martyrs were sacrificed to raise Haakon's army.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: A wizard aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent on his own perfection.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: An artificer who says artifice sundered the world.

entities.name: Aevar Borg
entities.description: A northern guide whose journal entries are quoted.

entities.name: Arkin Egilsson
entities.description: A skycaptain.

entities.name: Thangbrand Gyrdsson
entities.description: A Kjeldoran patrol member.

entities.name: Garza Zol
entities.description: A plague queen who feeds on the plagued.

entities.name: Lothar Lovisason
entities.description: A Balduvian chieftain.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: A Balduvian chieftain who leads her horde northwest against the ice wizards.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: A people whose magic is potent and primal.

entities.name: Ukoten
entities.description: A centaur chieftain.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: An elder druid of the Juniper Order.

entities.name: Juniper Order
entities.description: An order of druids and rangers protecting the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya.

entities.name: Taaveti of Kelsinko
entities.description: An elvish hunter.

entities.name: Ib Halfheart
entities.description: A goblin tactician.

entities.name: Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper
entities.description: An orc so cruel he burned his own followers, yet revered enough that they rose from their pyres to serve him.

entities.name: Karplusan
entities.description: A region of legend about Sek'Kuar.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Builders of death machines whose technology Heidar praises.

entities.name: The Dynasty of Winter Kings
entities.description: An in-world poem describing Terisiare under frost.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane whose fire still burned deep beneath the ice.

entities.name: Mishra's Bauble
entities.description: A trinket Heidar calls a delightful example of Phyrexian technology.

events.summary: The Knights of Stromgald strike Darien's Roost from two sides; Darien's tacticians prevent a pincer attack on Kjeldor.
events.quote: The Knights of Stromgald struck Darien's Roost from two sides.

events.summary: Darien fulfills his dream of unification and becomes the last king of Kjeldor.
events.quote: With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor.

events.summary: Freyalise speaks the World Spell, and the tamanoa rise to bring a new morning to Terisiare.
events.quote: When Freyalise spoke the World Spell, the tamanoa rose to bring a new morning to Terisiare.

events.summary: The Thaw meets Terisiare and mountains shed their ice, crushing homes.
events.quote: As the Thaw met Terisiare, mountains shed their icy skins, crushing homes and hopes alike.

events.summary: The World Spell thaws the icy graves of the dead, but Heidar calls them to duty.
events.quote: But Heidar called them to duty for a twisted cause.

events.summary: Heidar tells Haakon to dredge the lake at Tresserhorn for bones to build a new army.
Martyrs are sacrificed to the Frost Marsh to raise Haakon's army.
events.quote: they were sacrificed to the Frost Marsh to raise Haakon's army.

events.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes leads her horde northwest against the ice wizards.
events.quote: I lead my horde to the northwest.

events.summary: Kaysa sends Juniper Order druids to reclaim Yavimaya's borders from Heidar's second winter.
events.quote: Our border lands fall under the grip of Heidar's second winter.

events.summary: Heidar forces the sun into hiding.
events.quote: Heidar has forced the sun into hiding, but it has not forgotten us.

relations.quote: Darien became the last king of Kjeldor.
Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

relations.note: gives Haakon an army to build
relations.quote: We'll build you a new army

relations.note: protects the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya
relations.quote: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.
Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order
They would have caught Kjeldor in a pincer attack
